interpretation_guards: Short-sale trading volume and amount are flows, not outstanding positions.
KIS cumulative short-sale volume is not the KRX reported net short-position balance.
Stock lending/loan balances are not equivalent to short-sale trades or short-position balances.
Higher short-sale flow is not proof that price will fall.
Higher credit-loan balance or repayment is not proof of an imminent or executed forced sale.
Do not equate deal_date with settlement_date; sort and label each series on its stated date basis.
Show late, missing, corrected and threshold-limited data explicitly; never substitute synthetic values into a live report.
